content: साध्य {%a.%} [साध्-णिच् यत्] .²1 To be effected or accomplished, to be brought about; साध्ये सिद्धिर्विधीयताम् <ls>H. 2. 15</ls>. .²2 Feasible, practicable, attainable. .²3 To be proved or demonstrated; आप्तवागनुमानाभ्यां साध्यं त्वां प्रति का कथा <ls>R. 10. 28</ls>. .²4 To be established or made good. .²5 To be inferred or concluded; अनुमानं तदुक्तं यत् साध्यसाधनयोर्वचः <ls>K. P. 10</ls>. .²6 To be conquered or subdued, conquerable; स च त्वदेकेषुनिपातसाध्यः <ls>Ku. 3. 15</ls>; चतुर्थोपायसाध्ये तु रिपौ सान्त्वमपक्रिया <ls>Pt. 3. 27</ls>. .²7 Curable. .²8 To be killed or destroyed. .{@-ध्यः@} .²1 A particular class of celestial beings; साध्यानां च गणं सूक्ष्मम् <ls>Ms. 1. 22</ls>; विराट्सुताः सोमसदः साध्यानां पितरः स्मृताः <ls>Ms. 3. 195</ls>; <ls>Mb. 1. 1. 35</ls>. .²2 A deity in general. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a Mantra. .{@-ध्यम्@} .²1 Accomplishment, perfection. .²2 The thing to be proved or established, the matter at issue. .²3 (In logic) The predicate of a proposition, the major term in a syllogism; साध्ये निश्चितमन्वयेन घटितं … <ab>&c.</ab>; यत् साध्यं स्वयमेव तुल्यमुभयोः पक्षे विरुद्धं च यत् <ls>Mu. 5. 10</ls>. .²4 Silver.
